projectDescription: A free, open-source Chrome browser extension that adds an AI chat assistant directly inside the Scratch editor, letting you build and edit Scratch projects using plain natural language.
keyFeatures: AI-powered chat assistant embedded directly in the Scratch editor
Add, delete, and rename sprites from a natural-language prompt
Edit block scripts — motion, logic, events, sensing, variables, and more
Draw custom costumes and backdrops as SVG art
Generate a complete playable Scratch project from a single prompt
Attach images or focus on a specific sprite to guide AI edits
Green-flag test: runs the built scripts and reports whether they work
Export the finished project as a .sb3 file
Web-search Scratch tutorials (e.g. Griffpatch) for best practices
Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, xAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Moonshot, Meta Llama, Z.AI, and OpenRouter
New Chat button to reset the conversation
publicApiSurface: Chat input — natural-language prompt sent to the AI
Sprite selector — focus the AI on a specific sprite
Attach file — send an image to the AI for reference
Build button — execute an AI-generated action plan
New Chat button — start a fresh conversation
Settings (gear icon) — choose AI model and enter API key
Undo — revert the last AI action
Export Project — download the current project as a .sb3 file
Green-flag test — runs scripts and reports results
